about: The offertorium of the formulary “7th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: As though it were holocausts of rams and bullocks, or thousands of fat lambs, so let our sacrifice be in Your presence today, that it may please You; for those who trust in You cannot be put to shame, O Lord.
g: whole burnt offering, sacrifice wholly consumed by fires
